name: Calatayud (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Calatayud (a knight on horseback on yellow and red, with the motto AVGVSTA BILBILIS).
history: The municipal arms are party per pale or and gules, over all a knight armed at all points proper, holding in his right hand a lance with a pennon argent charged with a Greek cross gules, riding a horse argent; on a base argent the legend AVGVSTA BILBILIS in capital letters sable.
